# The look-alike table of the names check (scripts/names/fold.ts): one entry
# per line, a code point in hex and the folded Latin letters it looks like.
# Written by scripts/names/update-confusables.ts; do not edit it by hand.
#
# It is derived from confusables.txt of the Unicode Security Mechanisms
# (UTS #39), version 18.0.0:
# https://www.unicode.org/Public/18.0.0/security/confusables.txt
# SHA-256 6ed3ee967c9dfdf6677d563c9985182fbc50a2efb7d6059cd57b2e2ce18f5b92
# It keeps the characters outside ASCII that the data maps to Latin letters
# and that fold() does not read as those letters already: letters, digits,
# and symbols such as "│" for l. It leaves out what NFKC turns into Latin
# letters and what a hand-made table of fold() reads.
#
